---
title: "Best wine searcher"
---

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| message: false

library(dplyr)
library(plotly)
library(DT)

source("R/wrangle_wine.R")
wine <- get_wine_data()

max_vintage <- max(wine$vintage, na.rm = TRUE)
```

Hover over a country on the map to see its highest-rated wine from the last
10 vintages in the data (`r max_vintage - 9`\u2013`r max_vintage`) and its best
value-for-money wine (highest points-per-dollar) across all vintages.

```{r}
#| label: country-map
#| message: false

recent <- wine |>
  filter(!is.na(vintage), vintage >= max_vintage - 9, !is.na(country_iso3))

best_recent <- recent |>
  group_by(country_iso3, country) |>
  slice_max(points, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) |>
  ungroup() |>
  transmute(country_iso3, country, best_title = title, best_points = points, best_price = price)

best_value <- wine |>
  filter(!is.na(price), price > 0, !is.na(country_iso3)) |>
  mutate(value_ratio = points / price) |>
  group_by(country_iso3) |>
  slice_max(value_ratio, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) |>
  ungroup() |>
  transmute(
    country_iso3,
    value_title = title,
    value_ratio = round(value_ratio, 2),
    value_points = points,
    value_price = price
  )

country_summary <- best_recent |>
  left_join(best_value, by = "country_iso3") |>
  mutate(
    hover_text = paste0(
      "<b>", country, "</b><br>",
      "Best (", max_vintage - 9, "\u2013", max_vintage, "): ", best_title,
      " (", best_points, " pts",
      ifelse(is.na(best_price), "", paste0(", $", best_price)), ")<br>",
      "Best value: ", value_title,
      " (", value_points, " pts, $", value_price,
      " \u2014 ", value_ratio, " pts/$)"
    )
  )

plot_geo(country_summary) |>
  add_trace(
    z = ~best_points,
    color = ~best_points,
    colors = "YlOrRd",
    locations = ~country_iso3,
    text = ~hover_text,
    hoverinfo = "text",
    marker = list(line = list(color = toRGB("grey50"), width = 0.5))
  ) |>
  colorbar(title = "Best recent\nscore (pts)") |>
  layout(
    geo = list(
      showframe = FALSE,
      showcoastlines = FALSE,
      projection = list(type = "natural earth")
    )
  )
```

## Filterable wine data

```{r}
#| label: data-table

wine |>
  filter(!is.na(country)) |>
  transmute(
    title, country, province, variety,
    points, price, vintage,
    taster_name, winery
  ) |>
  datatable(
    filter = "top",
    rownames = FALSE,
    options = list(pageLength = 15, scrollX = TRUE)
  )
```
